CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) (CANDIDACY
DISQUALIFICATION) ACT 2023
1 Short title
This Act may be cited as the Constitution (Amendment) (Candidacy
Disqualification) Act 2023.
2 Commencement
This Act commences on the day appointed by the Minister by notice
in the Gazette.
3 Section 49 amended
Section 49 is amended:
(a) at the end of subsection 1(f), omit “or”; and
(b) at the end of subsection (1)(g), replace the full stop with a
semicolon and add “or”; and
(c) insert a new subsection (1)(h):
“(h) is also a candidate for election as a member of a Provincial
Assembly or of the Honiara City Council where the election of
members of Parliament, members of Provincial Assemblies
and members of the Honiara City Council are conducted at the
same date and time.”.
